underlying_goal: Implement a legacy ES reverse-sync feature in the incremental indexer that consumes Kafka CDC topics, transforms data to legacy ES schema format, and calls the legacy indexing API to keep the old ES in sync
friction_detail: Initial plan used port/repository pattern instead of the project's actual REST Client pattern, requiring multiple plan revisions after codebase exploration and multi-model review.
brief_summary: User requested a legacy ES reverse-sync implementation plan for their monorepo's incremental indexer; Claude produced a thoroughly reviewed architectural plan through iterative refinement but did not reach actual code implementation.
